ITEM 1 | Flat, thin strips of cooked meat with crisp, deep reddish-brown edges and lighter golden-amber centers; slightly glossy with rendered fat sheen, some strips curled and layered over one another, with crisped, brittle edges; roughly three to four strips, each about 12-15 cm long and 1-1.5 cm wide, covering about 20% of the plate on the upper-left side | 25
ITEM 2 | Loose, soft scrambled egg pieces in pale yellow with some darker golden flecks; crumbly, moist-looking clusters with irregular curds and small bits breaking off around the edge; no visible sheen or sauce; mounded in the center-right area covering about 25% of the plate, roughly 8-10 cm across and about 1.5-2 cm high | 60
ITEM 3 | Scattered small crumbs and bits of the same pale yellow scrambled egg lying loose on the plate surface, each about 0.5-1 cm across, no sheen, sitting around the edges of the main pile | 5
